personal.bio:
I am Abhishek Kumar, a Full Stack Web Developer and Computer Science Engineering student who enjoys building real applications that people can actually use. My journey has been shaped by practical learning, self-dependency, and hands-on project experience.

I have worked on comprehensive platforms like Doc Sansar, where I learned how to handle real users, structured content, databases, user interfaces, verification workflows, and performance in a live environment. I firmly believe in learning by building, improving step by step, and solving practical problems through clean code.

Currently, I am strengthening my programming fundamentals, specifically Java and DSA, while continuing to work on real-world web applications, enhancing system architectures, and improving my professional communication skills.

items.title: Building Doc Sansar: From Idea to 20K+ Users
items.problem: Students often struggle to find organized study materials in one place. Existing platforms were either too complex, required payment, or didn't cater to Indian university students specifically.
items.goal: Build a platform where students can access, upload, and share academic resources easily — free, organized, and student-friendly.
items.role: I handled everything: planning, development, database structure, UI design, backend logic, upload workflow, verification system, SEO, and continuous improvement.
challenges: Organizing diverse study materials properly across categories
Handling uploads and preventing low-quality or harmful content
Making the platform easy to use for non-technical students
Improving visibility through SEO without paid tools
Maintaining performance and usability as content grew
items.solution: Built a categorized platform with upload management, admin verification workflow, file preview, search functionality, user accounts, and an SEO-friendly URL and content structure.
impact: Ranked on Google within 7 days of launch
10K+ clicks in a single month through Google Search
Started generating AdSense revenue as a self-built product
items.learning: This project gave me a deep practical understanding of product building, user needs, SEO, database design, content moderation, and the continuous improvement mindset needed to run a real platform.
